meta.source: Company themes: Direction D, chosen 2026-10-08. personal-dark: JeffKazzee.dev live CSS, read 2026-10-08. Fonts are Google Fonts Latin subsets (OFL).

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background. JeffKazzee.dev source: --bg.

tokens.name: ground-alt
tokens.usage: Footer band, code blocks, quiet bands between sections. JeffKazzee.dev source: --bg-raised.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: Plates, offer boxes, cards, form fields. JeffKazzee.dev source: --surface.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines and primary text on ground, ground-alt and raised. 16.1:1, 15.3:1 and 16.0:1 on ground.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Body copy and nav links on ground, ground-alt and raised. 8.4:1, 9.8:1, 9.2:1 on ground.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Captions, dates, status words on ground and raised. 5.1:1, 5.7:1, 5.4:1 on ground. Company light on ground-alt is 4.7:1, so keep captions there at 13px or more.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairlines between sections and around plates. Decorative only, never the only edge of a control. JeffKazzee.dev source: --line.

tokens.name: field
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs and secondary buttons. 3.8:1, 3.1:1 and 5.0:1 on raised. JeffKazzee.dev has no field token: this reuses its ink-faint value.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Links, the now dot, the focus ring, plate numerals. 8.6:1, 8.7:1, 10.3:1 on ground. Company: oxblood in light, dusty rose in dark. JeffKazzee.dev: mint.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state of links and the primary button. JeffKazzee.dev source: --accent-bright.

tokens.name: accent-fill
tokens.usage: Primary button background. Text on it is on-accent.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on accent-fill. 9.4:1, 8.7:1, 10.3:1.

tokens.name: status-live
tokens.usage: The dot for shipped and live work. Always paired with a word. JeffKazzee.dev source: --accent-vivid.

tokens.name: status-wip
tokens.usage: The dot and word for work in progress. 6.1:1 and 8.6:1 on ground. JeffKazzee.dev source: --amber.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error text and the error notice edge. 6.8:1, 9.0:1, 9.5:1 on ground. Always with an icon or the word Error.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Confirmation text. 5.7:1, 9.6:1, 10.3:1 on ground. Always with the word Done or Sent.

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: Text selection background. Ink reads at 12.9:1 and 10.4:1 on it. JeffKazzee.dev source: --accent-tint.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.sample: Tools for the work you keep doing by hand.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Main project name, page titles. 40px on phones.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Project and offer names. Never below 24px: the face has one weight and gets thin.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Development build, Oct 3, 2026, before Claude Code sign-in.
styles.usage: Plate captions and the main-project numeral, in ink-faint or accent. The only italic in the system. Set from the separate Instrument Serif Italic file.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: I'm Jeff Kazzee. I build Vivary, a desktop workspace for AI agents.
styles.usage: The paragraph under a hero. 16px on phones. Max 52ch.

styles.name: text
styles.sample: We build your project together on a screen-share call.

styles.name: text-sm
styles.sample: An open-source database of 262 countries and territories.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Small labels and status words, sentence case. No uppercase labels in the company themes.

styles.name: jk-display
styles.sample: I build tools for working with AI.

styles.name: jk-body
styles.sample: I'm a self-taught developer working with AI coding agents.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight gaps inside controls. Equals JeffKazzee.dev --space (0.5rem).

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between buttons in a row.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Phone side margin. Plate padding is 14px on desktop, 8px on phones.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between a heading and its text.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Lede to buttons.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Between columns.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Desktop side margin of the page.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of a section on desktop. 56px on phones.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Hero top padding on large screens.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Plates and section bands in the company themes.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Company buttons and fields.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inline code.

tokens.name: radius
tokens.usage: JeffKazzee.dev cards and frames. Source: --radius.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: JeffKazzee.dev buttons.

tokens.name: shadow-none
tokens.usage: Company themes use rules and plates, not shadows.

tokens.name: shadow-rest
tokens.usage: JeffKazzee.dev cards at rest. Source: --shadow-rest.

tokens.name: shadow-soft
tokens.usage: JeffKazzee.dev cards on hover. Source: --shadow-soft.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Company body text line length. JeffKazzee.dev uses 66ch.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Company content width inside 64px margins.

tokens.name: site-max
tokens.usage: JeffKazzee.dev content width. Source: --site-max.

tokens.name: breakpoint
tokens.usage: One breakpoint, matching JeffKazzee.dev. Below it, columns stack.
